snyk.name: Snyk
snyk.status_detail: Still private. Business Insider (2026-08-28) reports Snyk marked down the value of its employees' shares; the Series G of December 2022 is the last priced round. No sale or listing found.

valuation.basis: Series G, USD 196.5M at USD 7.4B (company press release, 2022-12-12): the last priced round. The 2026 markdown of employee shares is not a priced round.

snyk.membership_detail: Earlybird led DeepCode's USD 4M seed (TechCrunch 2019-08-06: 'led by European VC firm Earlybird, with participation from 3VC and existing investor btov Partners'). Snyk bought DeepCode in September 2020; Unquote (2020-09-24, https://www.unquote.com/uk/official-record/3021146/vc-backed-snyk-acquires-btov-portfolio-company-deepcode): 'DeepCode's VC backers will now become shareholders in Snyk via a share deal.' No Earlybird fund is named in any Snyk financing round: the Series D (Addition, Sept 2020), Series E (Accel, Tiger; 13 further investors named, March 2021), Series F (Sands, Tiger, Sept 2021) and Series G (QIA, Evolution, G Squared, Irving, boldstart, Sands, Tiger; Dec 2022) announcements were read and none names Earlybird. The firm's own DeepCode page reads 'In 2020, DeepCode was acquired by Snyk' and its Snyk page gives 'Invested: 2020', the year of the DeepCode sale. The Snyk position is consideration from the DeepCode sale only.
snyk.notes: Developer security company (founded 2015, Tel Aviv and London; headquartered in Boston). Earlybird's Snyk shares came from the share deal in which Snyk bought DeepCode (Zurich), an Earlybird seed investment of 2019; no new Earlybird money in a Snyk round was found. DeepCode is a separate row on the firm's list (Exit).

Announced 2026-04-24; the definitive business combination agreement was signed 2026-09-16 and 'remains subject to final regulatory approvals', 'expected to close later this year'. The combined company will operate as Cohere with headquarters in Toronto and Berlin; Heidelberg stays as a research centre. Once it closes the row becomes acquired (acquirer Cohere). Schwarz Group, Aleph Alpha's Series B co-lead, commits EUR 500M to Cohere's next round.

The 'around $20 billion' in the Cohere coverage (TechCrunch 2026-04-25, SiliconANGLE 2026-09-16) is the combined company, not Aleph Alpha; no source read states the price paid for Aleph Alpha. SiliconANGLE puts Aleph Alpha's venture funding at about USD 126M.

Earlybird co-led the July 2021 Series A; the Series B article says only that 'existing institutional investors also participated', and WirtschaftsWoche (2026-04-24) still names Earlybird among the shareholders. North Data lists Aleph Alpha GmbH (Amtsgericht Mannheim HRB 732804) active (filings through 2026-10-01), with no liquidation or deletion entry. It absorbed thingsTHINKING GmbH, another row in this group, by merger on 2025-09-26. Status changes to acquired when the Cohere deal closes.
